items.html: And behold, from the aspect of the vessels of the kings, the vessels of the Mochin were also made. And from the aspect of the 288 sparks, the membranes that are within the vessels were made, and these sparks are the phase of Nefesh to these membranes. And from the lights that departed, which are the phase of Nefesh literally, and they are the HaVaYaHs and not the names of Elokim, from them the phase of the Mochin themselves was made. And it is found that the sparks, called the breath of the bones, which are the names of Elokim, become the Nefesh to all the external organs. And the internal lights, which are the HaVaYaHs, are the phase of Nefesh to all the internal organs, such as the heart and the lungs and the like.
